en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Commemorates Stefan (Stiv) Naumov, a people's hero of the WWII liberation war (per the source notes); origin of the song unclear, I cannot name an author. 'Одови' in the last line is my reading as 'from now on / for these times'; I rendered it loosely as 'for us'.

lines.cyr: - Долго трае овој пат, таа планина е висока
lines.lat: - Dolgo trae ovoj pat, taa planina e visoka
lines.en: - This road is long, that mountain is high,

lines.cyr: тешко ми е мили синко, ден да дочекам.
lines.lat: teško mi e mili sinko, den da dočekam.
lines.en: it is hard for me, dear son, to see the day.

lines.cyr: - Мојте маки имат крај, мојот пат е, мајко, слобода,
lines.lat: - Mojte maki imat kraj, mojot pat e, majko, sloboda,
lines.en: - My troubles have an end, my road, mother, is freedom,

lines.cyr: не ме жали мила мајко, ако загинам.
lines.lat: ne me žali mila majko, ako zaginam.
lines.en: do not mourn me, dear mother, if I fall.

lines.cyr: Стив Наумов знаеше храбро да се бори,
lines.lat: Stiv Naumov znaeše hrabro da se bori,
lines.en: Stiv Naumov knew how to fight bravely,

lines.cyr: Стив Наумов огреа како сонце в зори,
lines.lat: Stiv Naumov ogrea kako sonce v zori,
lines.en: Stiv Naumov shone like the sun at dawn,

lines.cyr: Стив Наумов остана во родните гори,
lines.lat: Stiv Naumov ostana vo rodnite gori,
lines.en: Stiv Naumov remained in the native forests,

lines.cyr: Стив Наумов слобода одови ни створи.
lines.lat: Stiv Naumov sloboda odovi ni stvori.
lines.en: Stiv Naumov made freedom for us.

lines.cyr: - Мојте маки имаат крај, мојот пат е, браќа, слобода,
lines.lat: - Mojte maki imaat kraj, mojot pat e, braḱa, sloboda,
lines.en: - My troubles have an end, my road, brothers, is freedom,
